responsibility: This header provides the MIPS Technologies Linux-specific target driver configuration, especially multilib and sysroot selection. It defines sysroot suffix construction from ISA revision, micromips, endianness, floating-point mode, NaN encoding, and libc variant, sets ABI-specific startfile search prefixes, and adds driver self-specs that infer ISA, float, synci, ABI, and FP ABI defaults before layering on the standard Linux MIPS specs.
